antigravity.name: Antigravity
antigravity.source: Live POST https://daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:fetchAvailableModels read with the credential the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.1.18) owns, 2026-09-03, reported defaultAgentModelId gemini-3.8-flash-high and a 1,048,576-token window for all three Gemini 3.8 Flash rungs; reconfirmed 2026-10-18. Gemini 4 Argon replaces the previous Pro lineup on 2026-10-18: live agy 1.4.1 --model gemini-4-argon-{low,medium,high} --effort {low,medium,high} --print turns each exited 0 with the requested echo response using the same subscription credential and daily endpoint. The agy log showed gemini-4-argon-low sent as the wire model id, display name Gemini 4 Argon (Low), and project default-cli-project. Argon uses the three id-encoded effort rungs, not thinkingConfig. The backend gates Argon on client identity: the same fetch read with Fleet's previous antigravity/ide/2.5.5 User-Agent omits Argon and its turns 404, while agy 1.4.1's antigravity/cli/1.4.1 identity (which Fleet now sends) lists all three Argon rungs with a 1,048,576-token window, thinkingLevel 1/2/3, and defaultAgentModelId gemini-4-argon-medium. providerModelId selects the medium rung following that upstream default; omitted request effort still follows the existing resolver default. Claude and GPT-OSS models are served by the same subscription but are deliberately not exposed here.

codex.name: Codex
codex.source: Codex current-generation model lineup and reasoning ladders; Fleet exposes one id per model, a fixed 500000-token context window, and an optional priority service tier selected by the fast flag. Context-window and service-tier variants are not model identities.

xai.name: xAI
xai.source: Official Grok CLI 1.0.40 models_cache.json from GET https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/models and live CLI ordinary/Fast replies observed 2026-09-22: grok-4.7 and grok-4.7-build-fast, 500000 context, low/medium/high/xhigh. grok-composer-2.5-fast retains the account-verified OpenCodex xAI identity and live Responses acceptance from 2026-08-19.

muse-code.name: Muse Code
muse-code.source: Fleet 실측(2026-09-25): 제품 라우터로 muse-spark-1.3-contributor 도구 루프 2턴(tool_use→tool_result→end_turn)이 HTTP 200 SSE로 성공했다. muse-spark-1.3과 아래 나머지 사양은 소스 기반이다. 모델 ID: Muse Code CLI 로그인 키로 GET https://api.meta.ai/v1/models 1회 실측(2026-09-25) — muse-spark-1.1/1.2/1.2-contributor/1.3/1.3-contributor와 비채팅 sam-3.1·muse-image-1.0·muse-voice-transcribe-1.0, capability 필드 없음. 현세대 1.3만 등록한다. 사양: oh-my-pi catalog rules meta.kdl·muse-code.kdl(2026-09-25 열람) — context 1048576, 최대 출력 131072, text+image, effort minimal~xhigh 및 1.3 standard의 max. contributor max는 지휘관이 직접 실측(2026-10-17T22:41:37Z~22:41:42Z): muse exec --model muse-spark-1.3-contributor --contributor-mode on --reasoning-effort max --max-model-steps 1 --workspace "$T" --json "Reply with exactly: OK"가 RC=0, run_terminal.text=OK, stream_succeeded, response_id=resp_6ad3f9a5f922a34ed9d44803으로 완료됐다. 단일 최소 프로브 1회로 max 요청 수락을 확인했으며 강도별 품질은 비교하지 않았다. minimal은 Fleet 노출 사다리 밖이라 low부터 노출한다. contributor는 같은 모델의 학습 동의 할인 SKU다. 와이어: https://api.meta.ai/v1/responses, x-api-version 1.0.0, tool_choice auto·function 도구만 허용(참고 소스 oh-my-pi 기록 2026-09-05/09-10; 거부 사례는 직접 미검증). 기본 모델 contributor는 비용을 보수적으로 잡은 Fleet 설계 선택이다. 벤치마크는 결합하지 않는다.
